data.body:
Correction completed and independently recomputed.

- R1–R10 are withdrawn as refuted production signals: R1 had FP=TP; R6/R9 had FP>TP; the rest had TP=0.
- Artifact-scoped guidance now distinguishes executable tickets, comments/handoffs, ADRs, user-facing docs, reference/API docs, incident/security records, and session logs.
- The fresh-agent check is now: current state, chosen path, constraints, proof, blocker, exact next action (no owner).
- Three retrospective ticket-only candidates meet the historical admission bar: S1 revision residue TP/FP/FN/TN=3/0/3/14; S2 cross-section echo saturation=2/0/4/14; S3 truncated acceptance residue=1/0/5/14. Their OR is 6/0/0/14.
- An independent reviewer re-fetched all 20 tickets through MCP and reproduced every fire. The perfect union is explicitly labeled resubstitution, not held-out validation; batch-local candidates had no TP outside their discovery batches, so none is approved for production enforcement.
- Full definitions, artifact contracts, sources, limitations, and the required held-out/rewrite-effect gate are in session_log 59a7-cb88-f2f9-4148. No repository files changed.
